subject: general
question: India's space programme was started by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Sarabhai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Indian Space Research Organisation **is the **national space agency **of **India**.
 
• It's **headquartered **in **Bangalore**.
 
• It **operates **under the **Department of Space **which is **directly overseen **by the **Prime Minister of India**, while the **Chairman of ISRO **acts as the **executive of DOS **as well.
 
• **Dr. Vikram Sarabhai**, the **founding father **of the **Indian space program**, quickly recognized the **benefits of space technologies for India**.
 
• **Vikram Ambalal Sarabhai **was an **Indian physicist **and **astronomer **who initiated **space research **and helped **develop nuclear power **in **India**.
 
• He was **honoured with Padma Bhushan in 1966 **and the **Padma Vibhushan in 1972**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO **was formed in **1969 **with a **vision to develop **and **harness space technology **in **national development **while **pursuing planetary exploration **and **space science research**.
 
• It **is one of the elite space agencies **in the **world over the years**.
 
• The major **ISRO **achievements of **2021**:
 
 
• **PSLV-C51/Amazonia-1**
 
• **Indian student satellites UNITYsat and Satish Dhawan SAT (SDSAT)** 
 
• **GSLV-F10/Gisat-1 (renamed to EOS-3): **Failed mission.
